name.value: Holiday Inn Express Fort St John

description.value: A Holiday Inn Express hotel in Fort St John, BC, providing standard midrange accommodation in a 3-level property. Suitable as a rest stop for touring cyclists passing through Northern BC.

raw_osm.name: Holiday Inn Express Fort St John

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website prefetch failed with an Access Denied error, preventing verification of amenities and contact details. OSM shows a valid Holiday Inn Express hotel with recent check_date (2026-03-05) and no closure indicators, confirming the business is open and real. OSM tags show internet_access=wlan, but per the rules, OSM amenity tags are not authoritative without website confirmation. All amenities are marked null due to unverifiable status.
concerns: Website fetch failed (Access Denied) -- unable to verify amenities or corroborate contact information
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open Holiday Inn Express property in Fort St John with recent OSM verification. Despite website access failure preventing amenity verification, the business is established, publicly accessible, and a legitimate rest stop for touring cyclists.
